<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state and test movement
def get_blue_positions(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    positions = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            positions.append((n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]))
    positions.sort()
    return tuple(positions)

state = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
print(f"Current: {state}")

# Test movement from current position
result = action(['UP'])
state = get_blue_positions(current_frame)

result = action(['LEFT'])

print(f"LEFT: {state}, gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

result = action(['RIGHT'])
state = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
print(f"RIGHT: {state}, gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")

# Check if any visible change happened
from collections import Counter
colors = Counter(n['color'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'])
print(f"\nColors: {dict(colors)}")

</function>
